nodes.label: getNotSubmittedItems - GET /pr/cs/not-submitted-items/{rfq_number}/{vendor_batch}
nodes.rationale: CS exception queue for RFQ items a vendor has not yet submitted. Uniquely among the CS review reads it also accepts a vendor_code query filter, allowing a multi-vendor batch to be narrowed to one vendor before chasing them. Bearer secured.

edges.source_location: shared rfq_number + vendor_batch addressing over vendor response state
